headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 13, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats. The New York Yankees also secured a win, taking down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 behind Paul Goldschmidt's 9th home run of the season. The San Diego Padres had a successful day, taking down the Baltimore Orioles 9-3 and 5-2 in separate matchups.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Michael Helman (Texas Rangers) and Keaton Winn (San Francisco Giants), who have been placed on the injured list. Freddy Fermin (San Diego Padres) is also out with a concussion, while José Ramírez (Cleveland Guardians) and Vinnie Pasquantino (Kansas City Royals) are dealing with fractures. Evan Carter (Texas Rangers) and Wilber Dotel (Pittsburgh Pirates) are also on the injured list.

The Cleveland Guardians traded Nolan Jones to the Chicago White Sox for Future Considerations. The Chicago White Sox also traded Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for Dylan Campbell and Jose Colmenares. The Milwaukee Brewers traded Jacob Waguespack to the Detroit Tigers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Paul Goldschmidt leading the offense. Goldschmidt hit his 9th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored Cody Bellinger.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Randy Vásquez earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samad Taylor led the Padres' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Mariners 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a decisive 8-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Cade Cavalli earning the win. Colt Emerson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates in their recent matchup. Impact players for the Marlins included Liam Hicks, Heriberto Hernández, and Joe Mack, while Max Meyer and Paul Skenes stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Fernando Tatis Jr. and Jackson Merrill contributing to the winning effort. Other notable performers included Rodolfo Durán, Gunnar Henderson, Jeremiah Jackson, and Blaze Alexander.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Michael Helman Lands on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Cleveland Guardians Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations on June 11, 2026.
